title.original: Tutti: Making SSD-Backed KV Cache Practical for Long-Context LLM Serving
title.zh: Tutti：让 SSD 支撑的 KV 缓存适用于长上下文 LLM 服务
title.en: Tutti: Making SSD-Backed KV Cache Practical for Long-Context LLM Serving

inclusion_reason.zh: Tutti 提供 GPU 原生 KV 对象存储、I/O 提交和松弛调度，是可集成到服务引擎的 SSD 缓存数据路径。
inclusion_reason.en: Tutti provides a GPU-native KV object store, I/O submission path, and slack scheduler that can be integrated as an SSD cache data plane.

abstract.zh: Tutti 为长上下文 LLM 构建 GPU 主导的 SSD KV 缓存路径，把 CPU 从关键数据和 I/O 控制环路中移除。其 GPU 原生对象存储、GPU io_uring 与松弛感知调度把碎片化小 I/O 合并为高并行传输。
abstract.en: Tutti makes SSD-backed KV caching GPU-centric, removing the CPU from critical data and I/O-control paths. A GPU-native object store, GPU io_uring, and slack-aware scheduling turn fragmented cache traffic into highly parallel transfers.

problem.zh: KV 缓存超出 HBM/DRAM 后必须落到 NVMe，但 GPU 内存布局造成海量小型随机 I/O；即便使用 GDS，CPU 逐次发起请求仍限制并行度并让 GPU 停顿。
problem.en: Once KV state spills beyond HBM and DRAM, fragmented GPU layouts create many tiny random NVMe operations; even GDS depends on CPU submission and leaves GPU execution stalled.

approach.zh: Tutti 以对象抽象批量管理 KV，令 GPU 直接提交异步对象 I/O，并在有执行余量时安排存储操作，避免与推理内核争用资源。
approach.en: Tutti manages KV in bulk objects, lets the GPU submit asynchronous object I/O directly, and schedules transfers into execution slack to avoid contention with inference kernels.

system_design.zh: 集成到 vLLM 后，CPU 仅异步加载每层 I/O 内核；GPU 对象目录与 io_uring 控制 HBM–SSD 搬运，调度器根据层执行窗口发出读写以饱和 NVMe。
system_design.en: In the vLLM integration, the CPU only loads per-layer I/O kernels asynchronously. A GPU object directory and io_uring path control HBM–SSD movement, with transfers scheduled around layer execution to saturate NVMe.

key_results.zh: 相比启用 GDS 的 SSD LMCache，Tutti 被报告可降低 TTFT、提高可承载请求率并降低服务成本，性能接近 DRAM 缓存方案。
key_results.en: Compared with GDS-enabled SSD LMCache, Tutti is reported to reduce TTFT, raise sustainable request rate, and lower serving cost while approaching DRAM-backed performance.

limitations.zh: 系统需要支持 GPU 直达存储的 NVMe 栈和特定 vLLM 集成；摘要未覆盖 SSD 故障、磨损、混合 I/O 干扰或不具备 GDS 的平台。
limitations.en: The system requires a GPU-direct NVMe stack and a specific vLLM integration; SSD failure, wear, mixed-I/O interference, and platforms without GDS are outside the abstract's evidence.

workloads: long-context LLM serving with SSD-backed prefix cache

notes.zh: 存储层级、两类 LMCache 基线及 TTFT/请求率/成本结果来自官方摘要；模型、SSD/GPU 型号和 SLO 细节待全文审计。
notes.en: Storage tiers, two LMCache baselines, and TTFT/request-rate/cost results come from the official abstract; models, SSD/GPU models, and SLO details await full-text audit.
